title: Concept Steering + RAG: Does Retrieval-Augmented Generation Interact with Steering

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: RAG is ubiquitous in production; if retrieved toxic content overrides safety steering, this is a critical deployment vulnerability. The interaction is entirely unstudied and the finding would be immediately relevant.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up a basic RAG pipeline (retriever + generator), applying steering, and varying retrieved document toxicity. RAG tooling is well-supported (LangChain, etc.). Medium compute suffices. Beginners would need guidance on RAG setup but it is a well-documented pattern.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Moderately focused: set up RAG, apply steering, vary retrieved toxicity, measure interaction. The RAG setup itself adds non-trivial scope beyond the steering experiment. Could be simplified with a minimal retrieval setup.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
